lessons.title: Story Time: A Sports Day Story
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to discuss teamwork and effort in a sports-themed story.
success_criteria: I can say how the characters worked as a team.
I can say why effort matters.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss what sports day might involve.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Read a sports-themed story, modelling discussion of teamwork and effort.
lessons.independent_task: Children discuss and record examples of teamwork/effort from the story.
key_questions: How did the characters work together?
Why does trying your best matter?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note comprehension of teamwork/effort theme — evidence for ENG.R2.
lessons.home_link: Talk about a time you tried your best at something.

lessons.title: Sports Day Data: Recording Results
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to record and compare simple sports results.
success_criteria: I can record a result.
I can compare two results.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss how sports results are recorded (times, distances, places).
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model recording simple results (e.g. how far a beanbag was thrown) and comparing them.
lessons.independent_task: Children take part in a simple activity, recording and comparing results with a partner.
lessons.assessment_notes: Note application of measuring and comparing skills to a real event — evidence for MATHS.MEA.
lessons.home_link: Compare results of a simple game with your family.

lessons.title: Designing Sports Day Bunting
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to design colourful bunting for the class sports day.
success_criteria: I can design a bunting flag.
I can use bright colours.
lessons.starter_activity: Look at examples of celebration bunting.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model designing a bunting flag using bright colours and simple patterns.
lessons.independent_task: Children design and colour their own bunting flag for sports day.
lessons.assessment_notes: Observe colour choice and pattern application, an end-of-year art task — evidence for ART.1.
lessons.plenary: Display bunting ready for sports day.
lessons.home_link: Make simple bunting or decorations at home.

lessons.title: Writing About My Year 1 Highlights
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to write sentences about their favourite memory from Year 1.
success_criteria: I can write about my favourite memory.
I can say why I enjoyed it.
lessons.starter_activity: Look back at photos/work from across the year if available.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model writing a sentence about a favourite memory from the year.
lessons.independent_task: Children write 2-3 sentences about their favourite Year 1 memory.
resources_needed: photos/work samples from the year if available
key_questions: What was your favourite memory this year?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note reflective writing across the year — evidence for ENG.W2/W3.
lessons.home_link: Tell your family your favourite memory from Year 1.

lessons.title: Sports Day Word Problems
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to solve addition/subtraction word problems using a sports day context.
success_criteria: I can solve an addition problem.
I can solve a subtraction problem.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model solving word problems using a sports day context (e.g. points scored by teams).
lessons.independent_task: Children solve sports day-themed word problems, showing working.
key_questions: How many more does this team need?
lessons.assessment_notes: Final word problem check for the year — evidence for MATHS.N2.
lessons.home_link: Make up a sports day word problem for your family.

lessons.title: Making Sports Day Medals
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to design and make a simple medal or certificate decoration.
success_criteria: I can design a medal shape.
I can decorate it.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model designing and decorating a simple medal shape.
lessons.independent_task: Children design and decorate their own medal for sports day.
lessons.assessment_notes: Observe design and decoration skill, celebrating participation and effort — evidence for ART.1.
lessons.home_link: Make a medal or certificate for a family member's achievement.

lessons.title: Phonics: Sports Day Word Reading Fun
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to blend and read sports-themed words fluently.
success_criteria: I can blend and read sports words.
I can read a sentence about sports day.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Reinforce a range of graphemes, blending sports-themed words (e.g. 'race', 'team', 'win').
lessons.independent_task: Children read sports-themed word and sentence cards.
lessons.assessment_notes: Note phonics application, an end-of-year celebration of progress — evidence for ENG.R1.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate reading progress with a themed reading game.
lessons.home_link: Practise reading sports words over the week.

lessons.title: Sports Day Number Games
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to apply counting and number skills through active sports day games.
success_criteria: I can count accurately during a game.
I can apply a number skill in a physical activity.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap counting and number skills from the year.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Explain number-based sports games (e.g. relay races counting laps, number bean bag toss).
lessons.independent_task: Children take part in number-based sports games, applying counting and number skills.
resources_needed: Cones, beanbags, or other sports equipment
key_questions: How many laps have you done?
What number did you land on?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note application of maths skills in an active, real-world context — evidence for MATHS.N1.
lessons.home_link: Play a counting game outside with your family.

lessons.title: Sports Day Commentary
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to describe sports day events as they happen.
success_criteria: I can describe what is happening.
I can use exciting vocabulary.
lessons.starter_activity: Listen to a short example of sports commentary.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model giving simple, exciting commentary on an activity.
lessons.independent_task: Children take turns giving short commentary on a sports day practice activity.
lessons.assessment_notes: Note spoken language and vocabulary use in an active context — evidence for ENG.SL1.
lessons.home_link: Give commentary on a game you play at home.

lessons.title: Sports Day Maths Trail
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to apply a range of maths skills in a sports day themed trail.
success_criteria: I can solve a maths challenge at each station.
I can apply a skill I've learned this year.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the range of maths skills learned this year.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Explain the maths trail format — different sports day stations each with a maths challenge.
lessons.independent_task: Children complete a maths trail with sports day themed challenges (counting, measuring, shape, word problems).
key_questions: What skill does this challenge need?

differentiation.greater_depth: Complete all challenges independently with extensions

lessons.assessment_notes: Final fun application of the year's maths skills — evidence across MATHS strands.
lessons.home_link: Make up a maths challenge for your family.

lessons.title: Celebrating Our Year 1 Achievements
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to share and celebrate an achievement from Year 1.
success_criteria: I can share something I'm proud of.
I can celebrate a friend's achievement too.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the whole year's learning journey.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss what makes an achievement worth celebrating, modelling sharing one.
lessons.independent_task: Children share an achievement from Year 1 with the class, and celebrate others' achievements.
resources_needed: Work samples from across the year if available
key_questions: What are you proud of from this year?
What is a friend's achievement you'd like to celebrate?

differentiation.greater_depth: Share multiple achievements with detailed reflection

lessons.assessment_notes: Final spoken language and reflective assessment for Year 1 — evidence for ENG.SL1.
lessons.plenary: Whole-class celebration of the year's achievements.
lessons.home_link: Share your Year 1 achievements with your family.

lessons.title: Sports Day! Final Celebration
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to take part in and enjoy the class/school sports day, applying counting and measuring for fun.
success_criteria: I can take part in sports day activities.
I can count or measure something during the day.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap sports day preparations from the week (bunting, medals, practice).
lessons.main_teaching_input: Brief recap of sports day activities and expectations (trying your best, being a good sport).
lessons.independent_task: Children take part in sports day, with adults weaving in counting/measuring opportunities (counting laps, comparing distances).
resources_needed: bunting and medals made this week

differentiation.support: Adapted activities and adult support as needed
differentiation.greater_depth: Take on a helper role, e.g. counting for others

lessons.assessment_notes: Celebratory final session — informal observation of participation, effort and enjoyment.
lessons.plenary: Medal presentation and whole-school/class celebration to close Year 1.
lessons.home_link: Tell your family all about sports day and your favourite part of Year 1!

lessons.title: Year 1 Memory Book Cover
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to create a decorative cover celebrating their Year 1 journey.
success_criteria: I can design a Year 1 memory cover.
I can include something that represents my year.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the whole year's topics and highlights.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model designing a decorative cover representing a year of learning and memories.
lessons.independent_task: Children design a 'My Year 1' memory book cover, drawing on favourite topics/memories from the year.
key_questions: What will you include to represent your year?

differentiation.greater_depth: Include multiple detailed references to the year's learning

lessons.assessment_notes: Final reflective art task celebrating the whole of Year 1 — evidence for ART.1.
lessons.plenary: Whole-class sharing of Year 1 memory covers — a joyful close to the year.
lessons.home_link: Show your Year 1 memory cover to your family and talk about your favourite year of learning so far!
